name: openstoa-mobile-typecheck-deps
//: TYPE-ONLY dependency root for `npm run typecheck` in the parent package.
Nothing here is bundled, imported at runtime, or shipped. It exists so the
mini-app's `tsc` has React Native + the host app's UI libraries to resolve
against in CI, where there is no `proofport-app` checkout next door to
borrow them from (it is a separate, private repository).
WHY IT IS NOT JUST `packages/mobile/devDependencies`: Metro resolves the
mini-app's imports by walking up node_modules from `src/`, so a second
copy of `react-native` in `packages/mobile/node_modules` would shadow the
host's and give the built app two React Natives. `typecheck/node_modules`
is not on any ancestor path of `src/`, so only tsc can see it — see the
VERSIONS ARE PINNED EXACT and must track proofport-app/package.json. A
drift here shows up as CI disagreeing with a developer's local tsc.
react-native-reanimated, which peers on a newer react-native than the host
pins. The host resolves that in its own tree; this root only needs the
declaration files, so npm's peer graph is not meaningful here.
